quantitative_claims.source_ref: Main text PDF p. 2, crossover scaling discussion
quantitative_claims.scientific_object: Crossover length L_c(gamma) proportional to exp(sqrt(gamma_0/gamma))
quantitative_claims.reason: No target extracts or fits the crossover length from independently generated finite-size data.

quantitative_claims.scientific_object: All higher QSD norm moments remain constant
quantitative_claims.reason: The attested clean-room formula output is accepted with an independent centered-QSD norm invariant.
The attested clean-room output is accepted through the exact projector identity n^2=n; the author expansion is not a numeric input.

quantitative_claims.scientific_object: For m>1 QSDc norm moments grow approximately at rate 2 gamma m(m-1)<n>^2
quantitative_claims.reason: The attested formula output is cross-checked by independent Gauss-Hermite integration of the QSDc stochastic process.

quantitative_claims.scientific_object: At gamma=0, C(0,tau) follows J_0(tau)^2 with tau^-1 envelope
quantitative_claims.reason: The attested analytic curve is cross-checked against an independent integral-quadrature definition of J0.

acceptance_criteria: The crossover-length target exposes a runnable formula but fails closed until gamma_0, the prefactor, and the operational finite-size criterion are supplied.
QSD and QJ norm conservation, QSDc moment growth, and the gamma=0 Bessel autocorrelation are evaluated directly from the printed analytic identities.
The runner reads no raw paper, original figure, author code, author numerical array, or digitized reference and never promotes scientific coverage.
T033-T036 require the independent final-disposition evaluator in outputs/checks/final_disposition_evidence.json; isolated formula evaluation alone never promotes coverage.
All 31 targets map to one of nine declared paper-scale families and all 1440 deterministic shards complete with exact, nonoverlapping trajectory indices.
